name: a collapsed sidebar keeps its layout box
why: Under MB's #page { display: table } a collapsed sidebar stays a table cell as wide as its min-content: the page runs past the table and every pinned bar stops that far short of the window edge (2026-10-14, area page).

name: no right-edge mask
why: A wide table ran on past the h2/h3 bars' line to the window edge, and rows showed beside a stuck bar (2026-10-14).
grep: ends on the h2/h3 bars' line

name: the mask is narrower than the bars' gap
why: Its width is the smallest gap between a pinned h2/h3 bar and the window edge; narrower, the table runs on past the line.
grep: ends on the h2/h3 bars' line

name: the mask lies under the table
why: It must paint over what scrolls, the stuck thead included. A plant at z-index 99 (just under the thead's 100) is invisible in this fixture: the thead's 100 is scoped inside an ancestor stacking context there and the mask (fixed, on <body>) is hit over it even at 99 (probed 2026-10-14). On MusicBrainz the thead competes directly and 102 > 100 decides; under the page content altogether (-1) is what the fixture can see.
grep: ends on the h2/h3 bars' line

name: the mask paints over body-level chrome (the footer)
why: Only what scrolls is covered; the pinned MB footer (106) reaches the window edge and stays on top.

name: the sticky thead has no backing colour
why: A sorted column's header tint is 60 % alpha; on the Springsteen sites nothing was behind it, and rows scrolling under the pinned header showed through (2026-10-14: brucespringsteen.it, then springsteenlyrics.com, whose Bootstrap table { background-color: transparent } also beat a zero-specificity backing).

name: the thead backing has no specificity (inside :where())
why: springsteenlyrics.com's Bootstrap table { background-color: transparent } then wins, and the rows show through the sorted headers there; brucespringsteen.it has no such rule.

name: a data table that is a direct <body> child is collected as chrome
why: jungleland.it: capped like a bar and raised over every stuck bar while hovered, the table's rows painted over the stuck h1, status line and h2 (2026-10-14, debug/jl.html).
